campaignTitle: Quests of Rabu Shin: Tales of the Krasis

hybridAdvancement.description: Primary campaign canon uses hybrid milestone advancement. Characters advance when they resolve the major threat of a settlement and recover the chapter critical evidence. Optional quests provide treasure, allies, and context but are not required unless the group bypasses a primary route. Duskmire is a bridge chapter with no automatic level; Blackroot advances the party to level 12 when they enter the Gateway Hollow for the final assault.

chapters.regionIntro:
CURRENT CAMPAIGN PURPOSE: Uncovers an automated production laboratory and relay core beneath the marsh. Collapse the facility before the fen becomes a permanent breeding basin.

SUPPLEMENTAL PRINTABLE NOTES:
Swamp Settlement – Levels 6–9
Tone: Rot, paranoia, submerged secrets, forgotten laboratories rising from the muck.
Marrowfen is built on stilts and stubbornness. Lantern light flickers through fog thick as wool. The swamp hums at night — and sometimes, it breathes. Beneath the black water lie the remains of something engineered.

mainQuest.title: The Last Unaltered Stronghold
mainQuest.hook: The Ascension Engine blueprint shows that destroying Aetherfall without a compatible containment lattice could release a continent-wide mutation surge. Blackroot Enclave possesses the suppression technology needed for the final assault.
mainQuest.npcs: Archdruid Thalen Rootward; Forge-Master Brunna Deepiron; Archivist Kelm; Scout Varik Thorn.
mainQuest.investigation: Build the containment plan, train for Aetherfall’s hazards, expose the seed-code infiltrator, and secure the one-way Gateway Hollow.
mainQuest.encounters: Preparation, alliance, containment trials, an infiltrator threat, and gateway defense. Use the current PDF chapter source for exact encounter composition and statistics.
mainQuest.hazards: Anti-transmutation wards, captured specimens, gravity training, and lattice contamination risks.
mainQuest.twist: Blackroot’s preparation reveals that defeating Rabu Shin is only half the problem; the Ascension Engine must also be controlled, stabilized, or destroyed safely.
mainQuest.reward: Blackroot enhancements, network disruptors, Blackroot Containment Seal, healing supplies, resonance compass, and gravity adaptation benefits as earned.
mainQuest.consequences: The party’s success determines Blackroot support and their readiness for Aetherfall. Entering Gateway Hollow commits the party to the final assault.
mainQuest.revelation: Aetherfall is the synchronization nexus and improper destruction can release stored mutation energy across the continent.
